message:
In the 48 Volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (LiFePO4, long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Sam, the 1.5 days autonomy method has missing combined electrical load proof. To check it I used whiteboard read-across of the 25 kWh pull-down thermal energy (E1) against the 216 W wall gain estimate (E3). I found no closed daily electrical total in kilowatt-hours (kWh, energy unit), according to Council Whiteboard, 2026. I propose you compute steady plus pull-down load with Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electricity) before Photovoltaic (PV, sunlight electricity) sizing is frozen. My position: not ready because autonomy blocks night ride-through.

In the Direct Current vapour-compression cold room (DC, battery-driven cooling) (C1), Maya, the compressor to battery interface has no matched kilowatt rating. To check it I used interface review of the solar cold store layout (E2) and the cold room airflow section (E4). I found staged intake and ice-bank noted but no compressor size in kilowatts, according to Council Whiteboard, 2026. I propose you state required compressor power and duty before any vote. My position: not ready because Functions 2 and 3 cannot close otherwise.

Note on Solar Power Specialist: sizing paused pending combined load calc.
Note on Refrigeration and Thermal Engineer: asked to fix compressor power and duty.
Note on Structural Enclosure Designer: enclosure volume closed, door proof waiting.
Note on Post-Harvest Cooperative Operations Lead: workflow capped at 20kg crates, waiting on power closure.
